replacements.El agente como bucle, no como flecha: The agent as a loop, not an arrow
replacements.Un agente no percibe, piensa y actúa en: An agent does not perceive, think and act in a straight line. It verifies, updates its state and observes again. The architecture is a closed loop with the objective at the center.
replacements.Percibe el entorno: mensajes, resultados: Perceives the environment: messages, results from previous tools, system state, images or documents. Everything that fits in the current context window.
replacements.Razona qué acción tomar dado el objetivo: Reasons about which action to take given the objective and what was observed. It can decompose complex tasks into substeps and select the appropriate tool before acting.
replacements.Lleva a cabo la acción: llamada a API, e: Carries out the action: an API call, code execution, search, text generation, or interaction with the physical or digital environment.
replacements.Evalúa el resultado. ¿Se logró lo espera: Evaluates the result. Was the expected outcome achieved? Was there an error? If it fails, the loop restarts with additional information. This stage distinguishes an agent from a chatbot.
replacements.Guarda lo relevante antes de volver a ob: Stores what matters before observing again. The context window is temporary; external memory persists across sessions. Without this stage, the agent repeats mistakes.
